summary: This clinical trial is testing the drug tirzepatide along with lifestyle changes in adults who have obesity, heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, and irregular heartbeats called atrial fibrillation. Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction is a condition where the heart muscle is stiff and does not fill with blood properly. The trial plans to enroll 602 participants and is sponsored by Yunlong Wang. It is currently listed as Phase 4 and is not yet recruiting.
